name: Tampere University of Applied Sciences
summary: Applied-sciences university in Tampere; nine English bachelor's, from software and textile engineering to nursing, media and a run-a-company degree.

ib.text: In the January joint application TAMK selects by the International UAS Exam, SAT, or a pre-task and interview, not on IB grades. Its engineering rolling admission takes IB with English 5 and HL Maths 5.

dates.label: Rolling admission closes, 15:00, unless places fill first
International UAS Exam, online from 12:00 Finnish time
Admitted: final certificate, or proof you have graduated, due 15:00

programmes.name: Environmental Engineering and Green Transition
programmes.about: Solving environmental problems for industry and the public sector: treating waste and water, and investigating and monitoring contaminated soil, water and air, with field and lab work.
programmes.ib: Rolling admission on IB grades (English 5, HL Maths 5) plus interview; in January, the UAS Exam or SAT.
programmes.selectionNote: January: UAS Exam (10 places) or SAT (5). Rolling, 15 Nov–28 Feb: IB grades or SAT, then an interview (rounds in Dec, Jan, Feb), until places fill.

programmes.name: Software Engineering
programmes.about: Software engineering for the international ICT industry, covering AI, cloud computing and cyber security, with sustainability and ethics throughout and project-based learning.
programmes.ib: Rolling admission on IB grades (English 5, HL Maths 5) plus interview; in January, the UAS Exam or SAT.
programmes.selectionNote: January: UAS Exam (35 places) or SAT (5). Rolling, 15 Nov–28 Feb: IB grades or SAT, then an interview (rounds in Dec, Jan, Feb), until places fill.

programmes.name: Textile and Material Engineering
programmes.about: Sustainable textile engineering: materials, manufacturing and industry practice, learned through projects, lab exercises and work with companies, with options to study or train abroad.
programmes.ib: Rolling admission on IB grades (English 5, HL Maths 5) plus interview; in January, the UAS Exam or SAT.
programmes.selectionNote: January: UAS Exam (8 places) or SAT (2). Rolling, 15 Nov–28 Feb: IB grades or SAT, then an interview (rounds in Dec, Jan, Feb), until places fill.

programmes.name: International Business
programmes.about: Practice-based international business with a required study period abroad and eight specialisation options, including accounting, digital business and sustainable entrepreneurship.
programmes.selectionNote: All 40 places go on the International UAS Exam (23 Mar 2027); IB grades do not count.

programmes.name: Business in Finland
programmes.about: A broad business degree with Finland-specific professional studies and Finnish built in, so you gain the skills to stay, work and build a career in Finland after graduating.
programmes.ib: International UAS Exam. Finnish language learning is built into the degree.
programmes.selectionNote: All 40 places go on the International UAS Exam (23 Mar 2027); IB grades do not count.

programmes.name: Team Entrepreneurship
programmes.about: Learning entrepreneurship by running real businesses with classmates at TAMK Proakatemia, through team learning and coaching rather than lectures, in an international community.
programmes.ib: Pre-task assignment with your application, then an online interview.
programmes.selectionNote: Pre-task due with the application (21 Jan 2027, 15:00); the top 160 get an online group interview on 9–11 Feb 2027. IB grades do not count.

programmes.name: Media and Arts
programmes.about: Practical skills for the international culture sector with new media tools, on one of three paths: Fine Art Lab, Interactive Media, or Music and Event Production.
programmes.ib: Pre-task assignment (published 26 November 2026) and an online interview; no English certificate needed.
programmes.selectionNote: Choose one path (Fine Art Lab 24, Interactive Media 33, Music 23 places). Pre-task (out 26 Nov) due 21 Jan 2027; online interview 9–11 Mar. IB grades do not count.

programmes.name: Early Childhood Education and Care
programmes.about: Early childhood education, social pedagogy and social services for non-native Finnish speakers, taught bilingually, qualifying you as an ECEC social pedagogue in Finland.
programmes.ib: International UAS Exam; English at B2. Aimed at non-native Finnish speakers.
programmes.selectionNote: All 20 places go on the International UAS Exam (23 Mar 2027); IB grades do not count.

programmes.name: Bilingual Degree Programme in Nursing
programmes.about: Training for Finland's regulated nursing profession, from basic skills to independent practice, with clinical placements and Finnish learned alongside nursing.
programmes.ib: International UAS Exam; English at B2. Taught in English and Finnish.
programmes.selectionNote: All 66 places go on the International UAS Exam (23 Mar 2027); IB grades do not count.

notes: Your IB grades count only in the engineering rolling admission; everywhere else you are chosen by an exam, SAT or pre-task.
Nursing, Early Childhood Education and Business in Finland build Finnish into the degree and are aimed at people who want to work in Finland.
Team Entrepreneurship (Proakatemia) replaces lectures with running a real company with your classmates.
